extension.name: Mitropolia - Dynamic Sources
extension.author: Romanian Orthodox Metropolia of the Americas
extension.description: Adds Mitropolia data to YOOtheme Pro dynamic content: the parishes a clergy member serves (with role), the clergy of a parish, the events and pastoral visits at a parish, and the parish of an event or visit. Uses only the documented YOOtheme source API and Joomla's own content model; if either is missing it does nothing.

field.name: assignments_field
field.label: Clergy assignments field (name)
field.description: Name of the repeatable subform field on clergy articles.

field.name: parish_subfield
field.label: Parish subfield (name)
field.description: Name of the SQL parish picker used inside the subform.

field.name: role_subfield
field.label: Role subfield (name)
field.description: Name of the role list used inside the subform.

field.name: group_field
field.label: Clergy group field (name, optional)
field.description: List field whose option order sets the directory order (hierarchs, priests, deacons). Leave empty to skip.

field.name: lastname_field
field.label: Last name field (name, optional)
field.description: Text field used for alphabetical order. Falls back to the article title.

field.name: event_start_field
field.label: Event start field (name)
field.description: Start date/time on event articles; sets the order.

field.name: itinerary_date_field
field.label: Itinerary date field (name)
field.description: Date on itinerary stops; sets the order.

field.name: carto_key
field.label: CARTO map key (optional)
field.description: Paste the CARTO basemaps key here to show the Voyager map on the parish directory and parish pages. Leave empty to use the standard OpenStreetMap map.
